label: common_2030_top_02
text: This is Geeta. How is your inspection of the\nGyms going?[VAR 0x0114(0011)]

label: common_2030_select_02
text: Uh, how did you get my number...?[VAR 0x0114(0011)]

label: common_2030_top_03a
text: You’ve done a wonderful job. Thank you.[VAR 0x0114(0011)]

label: common_2030_top_03b
text: Heh... I’m the head of the organization. I have\nthe addresses and contact information of every\r\nChampion-ranked Trainer.[VAR 0x0114(0011)]

label: common_2030_top_04
text: I was informed by each of the Gym Leaders\nthat you stopped by to see them.[VAR 0x0114(0011)]

label: common_2030_top_05
text: I knew giving you this task was the right decision,\nChampion [VAR 0x0100(0000)].[VAR 0x0114(0011)]

label: common_2030_top_06
text: All of them seemed quite happy for the\nopportunity to battle you.[VAR 0x0114(0011)]

label: common_2030_top_07
text: Now, I would like the inspection report from you\nin person.[VAR 0x0114(0011)]

label: common_2030_top_08
text: Join me at the academy in the entrance hall.[VAR 0x0114(0011)]

label: common_2030_top_09
text: I will be waiting for you there.[VAR 0x0114(0011)]
